items.headline: Rays are one win from the World Series — Tampa grabs a 3-2 ALCS lead
items.body: Drew Rasmussen spun seven strong innings and Liam Hicks knocked in a run as the Rays beat Cleveland 3-1 in Game 5. Tampa Bay heads home needing just one more win to reach its first World Series since 2020 — Game 6 is tonight at the Trop.
items.say: Did you catch the Rays? One win from the World Series and Game 6 is tonight — Tampa's been the story of October.

items.headline: Ugly but golden — Madueke's late deflected winner keeps Arsenal in the title race
items.body: Noni Madueke's 80th-minute strike took a wicked deflection to sink Nottingham Forest 1-0 at the City Ground — and it was Arsenal's only shot on target all afternoon. The grind-it-out win keeps the Gunners three points behind league leaders Manchester City.
items.say: Arsenal won 1-0 at Forest with basically one shot on goal — sometimes you just need the three points, right?

items.headline: Cold night at Lambeau — Packers handle the Cowboys 23-13
items.body: Jordan Love threw two touchdowns and rookie Matthew Golden racked up 104 receiving yards as Green Bay bottled up Dak Prescott (two interceptions) under the Sunday-night lights. Dallas has now dropped two in a row for the first time this season.
items.say: Packers took care of the Cowboys at Lambeau on Sunday night — Jordan Love's really starting to roll.

items.headline: Back-to-back kings — FURIA survive a five-map thriller to defend their CS2 world title
items.body: Brazil's FURIA rallied to beat BetBoom 3-2 in the Thunderpick World Championship grand final in Malta, closing out the decider 13-6 to repeat as champions and bank the $1,000,000 top prize. KSCERATO was named tournament MVP.
items.say: FURIA went the full five maps and defended their CS2 world title over in Malta — the Brazilian fans must have gone nuts.

items.headline: Knockout of the year? Mike Malott flattens Joaquin Buckley with a brutal knee
items.body: In front of his home Canadian crowd in Edmonton, Mike Malott ended Joaquin Buckley with a thunderous knee in the second round of the Fight Night main event — an instant front-runner for Knockout of the Year.
items.say: Did you see that Malott knockout in Edmonton? A knee out of nowhere in round two — the whole arena erupted.

items.headline: Hadouken at the box office — 'Street Fighter' opens at No. 1 with about $31M
items.body: The long-awaited live-action Street Fighter — Andrew Koji as Ryu, Noah Centineo as Ken, and a cast loaded with WWE stars like Jason Momoa and Roman Reigns — punched its way to the top of the weekend box office with roughly $31 million.
items.say: The new Street Fighter won the box office this weekend — did you grow up mashing buttons on that game?

items.headline: Two pop titans, one game show — Olivia Rodrigo and Chappell Roan drop the 'expectations' remix
items.body: Olivia Rodrigo reworked her hit 'expectations' with Chappell Roan — Roan's first-ever guest feature — and the pair's chaotic, retro game-show music video has fans completely obsessed.
items.say: Olivia Rodrigo and Chappell Roan teamed up on a remix with the most chaotic little game-show video — have you seen it?

items.headline: Before Jason, there was Pamela — A24's 'Crystal Lake' lands on Peacock
items.body: Peacock dropped all eight episodes of Crystal Lake, the A24 Friday the 13th prequel set in 1971, with Linda Cardellini as a grieving Pamela Voorhees. Pretty much perfect spooky-season binge material.
items.say: There's a new Friday the 13th prequel on Peacock with Linda Cardellini as Jason's mom — great Halloween-season watch.

items.headline: Vision gets his trilogy capper — Marvel's 'VisionQuest' arrives on Disney+
items.body: Paul Bettany is back as Vision (with James Spader's Ultron lurking) in VisionQuest, the Disney+ series completing the trilogy that began with WandaVision and ran through Agatha All Along.
items.say: Marvel finally gave Vision his own show on Disney+ — if you liked WandaVision, this picks the thread right back up.
